title: Smug cats under the streetlight: the pet stare-down
summary: One photo of your cat becomes a moody night clip where it sits by the road beside another cat, both looking far too pleased with themselves.
why: AI Trend Club's list, updated November 16, 2026, marks "Cat Mogging" as a new trend from a TikTok posted November 13, 2026 that showed 2.6M views and 480K likes on November 16: a grey kitten in little glasses sits beside a white kitten by a dark road under streetlights, both holding a smug look, then a close-up of one exaggerated face. Our October pack "Smug head shake" was one pet; this one is a side-by-side duo at night.
steps: Pick a clear photo of your cat (or two cats) where the face is sharp and well lit.
Upload it to an image-to-video tool and paste the main prompt.
Make a few versions. Keep the one where your cat still looks like your cat and the close-up lands.
Add a slow, dramatic song from your app's sound library and a caption like "Nobody does it like us."

prompts.label: Main prompt
prompts.text: Animate this photo as a 12-second vertical clip. Night, a quiet roadside lit by warm streetlights, with soft glow on the pavement. The cat from my photo sits upright beside a second cat, both facing the camera. My cat wears tiny round glasses. Both cats hold a calm, smug look, chins slightly raised. They slowly turn their heads toward each other, then back to the camera. Cut to a close-up of my cat's face as it narrows its eyes in a very pleased expression. Keep my cat's fur colour, markings and face exactly as in the photo. Static camera, moody cinematic lighting, funny mood. No text, no logos.

prompts.label: Variation: two of your own pets
prompts.text: Use both pets from this photo. Night, a quiet street under orange streetlights. The two pets sit side by side on the curb, very still and very serious. One slowly lifts its chin. The other copies it a moment later. Close-up on each face in turn, both looking smug. Keep each pet's fur, markings and face exactly the same. Static camera, moody night look, funny. No text, no logos.

prompts.label: Variation: snowy night
prompts.text: A snowy sidewalk at night, with light snow falling through the glow of a streetlight. My cat sits on a snowbank in a tiny knitted scarf, beside a second cat. Both stare at the camera with a smug, unbothered look while snowflakes land on their fur. Slow push-in to my cat's face as it blinks slowly. Keep my cat's fur and face exactly the same. Cinematic and cosy. No text, no logos.

prompts.label: Variation: small business
prompts.text: Night, a quiet street outside a small shop with a warm light in the window. My shop cat sits on the step beside a [my product], both lit by the streetlight. The cat looks at the product, then back at the camera with a smug, approving look. Close-up on the cat's face. Keep the cat's fur and face, and the product, exactly the same. Static camera, moody night look, playful. No logos, no text.

tips: Keep the joke on the cats. Don't use it to compare or rate how people look.
A sharp, front-facing photo keeps your cat's markings from drifting.
Night scenes can get grainy. If it looks muddy, ask for warmer, brighter streetlights.
Say it's made with AI in your caption.
